title: Demotion
caption: Demotion (V)
game_text: Use 2 Force to deploy on an Imperial leader of ability < 5 or a senator. That character’s game text is canceled. If present with another Demotion, this Effect lost.
lore: Repercussions for failure are severe in the Imperial military. Many officers prefer demotion to ‘alternative’ punishment from Darth Vader.
